verdict.rationale: Clerk documents built-in protection on its auth flows: ML-based bot detection and multi-account protection that neutralize attacks in real time, built-in brute-force prevention on email/SMS one-time passcodes, disposable-email blocking, and hourly sign-up limits per email domain and shared infrastructure. The evidence is first-party marketing and changelog material only. missing for 10: explicit credential-stuffing protection (e.g., breached-password checks), password-attempt lockout or rate-limit details, in-depth configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
